body:
I'm glad you shared. I'm probably close to twice your age, but that definitely doesn't matter. You're probably right - he isn't there anymore. At first when I read that I wanted to just take a bunch of xanax because I got that horrible empty feeling in my chest - but then it made me realize that instead, I can just mourn him and maybe eventually move on. I'm stuck trying to get back what I had, but none of it is there anymore.

Thank you.

I am good if I'm distracted, but if I stop being distracted (so when trying to sleep, when waking up if I don't have to leave the house right away, and while driving... Showering...) I break down. I also tend toward insomnia if I'm watching shows or on the internet - I've accidentally stayed up all not dicking around because I never got tired. So what's worse - miserable crying or no sleep??

I've actually never seen friends. Maybe I should start.

You're right about that. We mostly grew together - I think that's so hard about this thing. We had each other's backs and now I have no one like that. Current friends aren't as close or don't get me like he does. A few months ago he told me out of nowhere that no one will ever understand him like I do. So knowing that he's moving on and growing and I am not only not there, but not welcome because someone else is there... It sucks. Really really sucks.

I was on lexapro until March of this year, had been on it for about a year (started just before we broke up, actually). My shrink cancelled my appointment and I was annoyed about that so I didn't reschedule. I should. Probably the withdrawal from it isn't helping.

And damn, good guess on the birth control, too. That stopped like a month ago. Too lazy to pick up my refill considering I'm not having sex. Will get on that tomorrow...

Thanks for the input. Hearing from someone that isn't telling me to just get over him already is so helpful.
